evidence.reason: `_expand_instance` substitutes both `%i` and `%I` with the parsed, still-escaped instance text. In systemd, `%i` is the escaped instance while `%I` is the unescaped instance. Thus for `ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket`, `Service=%I.service` should resolve to `crq-tick.service`, but the code produces `crq\x2dtick.service`, causing the dependency reference to be missed. This is an implementation error in the existing `%I` handling; the smallest fix is to unescape only the `%I` replacement.
